title: Aspen Search header
description: A sticky 60px bar split on the page's middle line: an ink logo square and the live time of two cities (flipping between them as you scroll) on the left; section links, a tiny light/dark switch and a 200px ink Contact button on the right. Link text rolls up over a rising ink fill on hover; Contact gets a mint sweep. On phones the right half is a mint Menu button.
notes: needs JavaScript for the phone menu and the live clocks; the city flip is a CSS scroll(root) animation
the switch toggles .dark on <html>; leave themeToggleLabel out to hide it
name: aspensearch-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the firm's name, for screen readers on the logo square

props.name: logo
props.description: the mark in the ink square on the left; empty: a plain asterisk icon

props.name: cities
props.description: one or two cities whose live time shows next to the logo; with two, they flip as the page scrolls

props.name: links
props.description: the section links (desktop row, phone menu)

props.name: contact
props.description: the ink button on the right

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the phone menu button, e.g. "Menu"

props.name: themeToggleLabel
props.description: shows the little light/dark switch, which toggles `.dark` on <html>; its value is its screen-reader name
